seed_fields.description: Project rays to a cylinder, then weight transverse coordinates. Coordinates and reference_radius use the same caller-defined length unit; transverse_weight is dimensionless. Axis points and nonfinite arithmetic reject. Empty batches return shape (0, 3). Multiplication precedes division to preserve the retained source's floating-point evaluation order.

interfaces.name: coords
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 array (N,3), including empty batches. Consistent caller-defined length units. Cylindrical projection requires finite nonzero transverse norm; plane projection requires nonzero axial coordinate. Nonfinite arithmetic rejects.

interfaces.name: reference_radius
interfaces.constraints: Positive finite real scalar in the coordinate length unit.

interfaces.name: transverse_weight
interfaces.constraints: Finite real dimensionless weight for the first two projected coordinates; caller policy, default 1.0.

interfaces.name: projected
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 array (N,3) for cylindrical projection or (N,2) for plane projection; source arithmetic order retained. No detector or neighbor-selection policy.

seed_fields.description: Project rays from the origin onto z=reference_height; return x,y. Coordinates and reference_height use the same caller-defined length unit. Points on z=0 reject; negative heights and empty batches are supported.

interfaces.name: coords
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 array (N,3), including empty batches. Consistent caller-defined length units. Cylindrical projection requires finite nonzero transverse norm; plane projection requires nonzero axial coordinate. Nonfinite arithmetic rejects.

interfaces.name: reference_height
interfaces.constraints: Finite real axial plane coordinate in the coordinate length unit; either sign or zero is allowed.

interfaces.name: projected
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 array (N,3) for cylindrical projection or (N,2) for plane projection; source arithmetic order retained. No detector or neighbor-selection policy.

limitations: Draft source/interface intake only; semantic publication and dependency gates remain.
Generic numerical projections with caller-defined units and reference geometry; tracking policy stays in the recipe.
